description: Create a new link for the authenticated user. Optionally set link.domain to a verified custom domain hostname owned by the account. Pro accounts may set link.slug to choose the short-link path; Free/Standard get an upgrade_required error (entitlement links.custom_slug), an invalid slug returns invalid_slug (status 400) with the failed rule, and a slug that is already taken returns slug_taken (status 409) so you can retry with another slug. When source, medium, and campaign are not all set, the tool returns status utm_required with missing, recommendations, and a conversational message — ask the user to confirm, then re-call with all three UTM fields; no link is created until then. The result includes shortUrl, the full short link on the link's own domain; show it to the user as-is.

domain.description: Optional verified custom domain hostname owned by the authenticated account

longUrl.description: The destination URL to be shortened

name.description: The name/path for the shortened URL

previewDescription.description: Optional Open Graph description shown when the short URL is shared on social platforms

previewImageUrl.description: Optional public HTTP or HTTPS image URL used as the Open Graph preview image (HTTPS recommended)

previewTitle.description: Optional Open Graph title shown when the short URL is shared on social platforms

slug.description: Optional custom short-link path (Pro only). 3-30 characters: lowercase letters, numbers, hyphens, and underscores; cannot start or end with a hyphen; reserved and profane words are rejected. Input is trimmed and lower-cased. Omit to get a generated 7-character path.

name: createLink
title: Create a new link
